text: NOTES: (1) In R-1 and R-2 Districts, minor dependent children in the care of a parent or relative shall be excluded in determining the number of unrelated occupants. (2) Properties in the South Hill Overlay District with a zoning designation of R-1 or R-2, see §325-8(E). (3) Properties less than 60,000 SF may only have one primary structure. Properties greater than 60,000 SF may have two primary uses, if approved by ILPC and Planning Board. Properties with at least 90,000 SF can have as many as three primary uses if approved by ILPC and Planning Board. (4) See §325-3 for occupancy restrictions. (5) Restricted to one every 500 feet for new construction, measured from the edge of the property line. (6) For not more than three cars. (7) For not more than six cars per building. (8) Not to remain for over two years.
